Coverage_Description: Accidental death/loss of use or dismemberment up to 100% of notional amount; total disablement benefit 1% of notional amount per month (after 12 consecutive months of disability, with injury resulting within 180 days of accident); medical indemnity reimbursement up to 6% of notional amount per accident with treatment sub-limits
pricing: Premium rate (HKD, per HKD1,000 notional amount/year): Band 1 Class 1 4.62 / Class 4 9.24; Band 2 Class 1 3.42 / Class 4 6.84
customer requirement: No health questions at application; aimed at customers able to pay ongoing premiums for protection
price structure: Yearly renewable and non-guaranteed; payment mode annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly
additional informations: No savings element or cash value; premium payment period and benefit period up to age 75; includes International Medical Assistance and Mainland China Hospital Admission Guarantee services
